text: In December 2022, the Federal Government established the VIA Rail Subsidiary—VIA High Frequency Rail to support High Frequency Rail. The High Frequency Rail (HFR) project is a proposed investment to create a new train network that will run on mostly dedicated tracks at higher frequencies, higher speeds and with greater reliability between Toronto and Québec City. The High Frequency Rail project presents a unique economic development opportunity by: Achieving greater connectivity for people living in and around major cities and communities between Toronto and Québec City, and to major airports and universities/ colleges in the region. Supporting economic growth by creating new employment opportunities in infrastructure, in new centres of economic activity and bringing people closer to markets and businesses.
